{{Quote|I've got a friend in CorSec named Shaedra Valouri. She's helping me track a few leads that will break this case. Go and pick up what she has for me. She's meeting you outside of town in case corrupt officers try and stop her.|Denell Kel'Vannon to a spacer|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Shaedra Valouri''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was murdered after it was discovered that she helped her friend, [[Denell Kel'Vannon]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecTrooperMaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Randomly generated male depiction of Shaedra Valouri, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Shaedra Valouri was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Shaedra Valouri spawned under the generic "corsec_lieutenant" template, her appearance was randomized under one of four possible depictions. She could either appear as a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Human male wearing either an [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] or a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], or as a brown haired, brown eyed Human female wearing either the officer's uniform or pilot's jumpsuit. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Valouri as female, this article assumes that the Human female depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. However, the type of clothing she wore cannot be definitively determined.<ref name="AED" />
